name: com.knowchelsea/places
title: KnowChelsea
description: Curated places in Chelsea, London: restaurants, coffee, pubs, parks and shops.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Curated places in Chelsea, optionally filtered by category, use-case tag or featured picks. Each result links to its https://knowchelsea.com/place/{slug} page. rankedUrl is https://knowchelsea.com/best/{category} for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop, and https://knowchelsea.com/best for every other category.

category.description: Place category, for example coffee or restaurant

tag.description: Use-case tag, for example brunch or with-kids

featured.description: When true, only return featured picks

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full record for one Chelsea place by slug: the guide's description and tip, address, coordinates, opening hours, website and the public /place URL. Use it for hours or an address, and for the coordinates of a station or landmark before calling nearby_places. openNow says whether the place is open at londonTime by its listed hours (null when the hours cannot say); to answer what is open now, call it for each candidate. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Nearest curated Chelsea places to a WGS84 coordinate, with distance in metres. For places near a station or another place in the guide, take the coordinate from get_place (stations are places in category transport) and filter by category here.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Filter curated Chelsea places by category, sub-zone, tags, featured picks or text, ranked the same way as the published best-of lists. Every field carries its source; addresses, coordinates, hours and websites are not included, so call get_place for them. It cannot filter by opening hours: for what is open now, search here, then read openNow from get_place for each candidate. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

category.description: Place category, for example coffee or restaurant

tags.description: Use-case tags; a place must carry every tag given

featured.description: When true, only return featured picks

query.description: Text matched against names and the guide's descriptions and tips

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Side-by-side sourced records for 2 to 4 Chelsea places by slug, with the tags they share. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Published Chelsea themed guides (https://knowchelsea.com/guides/{slug}), with sourced titles, summaries and place counts.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One published Chelsea guide by slug: its introduction and its ranked places, every field sourced. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

slug.description: Guide slug from list_guides, for example brunch
